description: Source code for the TimeClient Request Handler class, managing TR-069 interface interactions for device time settings, including get/set handlers, notifications, and update checks.

classes.name: TimeClientReqHandler
classes.description: Handles TR-069 interface requests related to device time, including get/set operations, notifications, and periodic update checks.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the handler; currently not implemented.

methods.name: unInit
methods.description: Closes all time client instances and cleans up.

methods.name: handleSetMsg
methods.description: Processes set requests for device time parameters.

methods.name: handleGetMsg
methods.description: Processes get requests for device time parameters, including local time, timezone, status, and UTC time.

methods.name: registerUpdateCallback
methods.description: Registers a callback function for update notifications.

methods.name: handleGetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles get attribute requests, mainly for notification settings.

methods.name: handleSetAttributesMsg
methods.description: Handles set attribute requests, mainly for notification settings.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for changes in time settings and triggers update callbacks if needed.
